title: HelpingDoctors EHR
description: Bundled preset — colour + typography combined. For independent axes use colours/helping-doctors and typography/helping-doctors.

presets.name: Whisper
presets.shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 10%, transparent), 0px 0px 0px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 5%, transparent)

presets.name: Soft
presets.shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent), 0px 4px 12px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 10%, transparent)

presets.name: Lifted
presets.shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 5%, transparent), 0px 4px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 8%, transparent), 0px 12px 24px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 12%, transparent)

presets.name: Floating
presets.shadow: 0px 2px 4px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 4%, transparent), 0px 8px 16px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent), 0px 24px 48px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 12%, transparent), 0px 48px 96px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 10%, transparent)

presets.name: Crisp
presets.shadow: 0px 1px 1px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 16%, transparent), 0px 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 14%, transparent)

presets.name: Long
presets.shadow: 0px 2px 1px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 4px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 8px 4px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 16px 8px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 32px 16px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent)

presets.name: Outline
presets.shadow: 0px 0px 0px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 14%, transparent), 0px 2px 8px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent)

presets.name: Grounded
presets.shadow: 0px 20px 20px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 26%, transparent), 0px 1px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent)

presets.name: Glow
presets.shadow: 0px 0px 16px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 55%, transparent), 0px 0px 40px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 28%, transparent)

presets.name: Pressed
presets.shadow: inset 0px 2px 4px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 14%, transparent), inset 0px 0px 0px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent)

shadowHover.floating: 0px 3px 5px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 4%, transparent), 0px 10px 20px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent), 0px 30px 60px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 14%, transparent), 0px 60px 120px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 12%, transparent)
shadowHover.crisp: 0px 2px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 16%, transparent), 0px 4px 8px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 14%, transparent)
shadowHover.long: 0px 3px 1.5px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 6px 3px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 12px 6px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 24px 12px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent), 0px 48px 24px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 9%, transparent)
shadowHover.outline: 0px 0px 0px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 14%, transparent), 0px 4px 12px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent)
shadowHover.grounded: 0px 26px 24px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 30%, transparent), 0px 1px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 6%, transparent)
shadowHover.glow: 0px 0px 20px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 70%, transparent), 0px 0px 52px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--preset--color--primary) 40%, transparent)
